land-110m.json — world-atlas 2.0.2 (https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas, ISC licence),
TopoJSON built from Natural Earth 1:110m data (public domain, https://www.naturalearthdata.com/). Unmodified.
korea-10m.json — South Korea from world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-10m.json (Natural Earth 1:10m, public domain),
decoded to GeoJSON with coordinates rounded to 4 decimals; nothing else changed.
Used only by the opening globe intro in static/app.js (the land, and South Korea's coast and fill on the MapLibre globe).
